title: Installable component descriptor
description: Describes one deployable unit consumed by the installer core. See docs/packaging-design.md §0B.

id.description: Stable identifier, unique across components; also the folder name.

name.description: Human-readable name shown in the wizard.

kind.description: service = native WinSW/systemd process; container = Compose-managed service; static = files only; external = customer-provided dependency.

required.description: When true the component cannot be deselected on the components page.

binary.description: Executable path relative to the install root, per platform.

port.description: Listening port; may reference an installer variable such as ${APP_PORT}.

env.description: Environment set on the service definition; values may reference installer variables.

config.description: Environment keys this component owns in the generated .env.

dataDirs.description: Writable directories created under the data root and granted service access.

provisioning.description: CLI subcommands the installer shells out to (docs/cli-provisioning-spec.md).

servedBy.description: For kind=static: the component that serves these assets.

dependsOn.description: Ids that must be installed and started before this one.
